description: Saneamento Básico: Depósito de Abastecimento de Água RF1 (Área) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Base cartográfica digital da Região Funcional 1 com geoinformações atualizadas, compatível à escala de 1:25.000, com Padrão de Exatidão Cartográfica (PEC) Classe A, a partir de ortoimagens digitais com resolução espacial de 35cm, datadas de 2019, contemplando classes das seguintes categorias de informação: Agricultura, Biota, Limites, Ciências Atmosféricas, Economia, Elevação, Ambiente, Geocientífico, Saúde, Imagens e ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Cartografia de referência e imageamento, Serviços públicos e comunicação, Downloadable Data, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover, intelligenceMilitary. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
